title: Synthesis 7: heredity by intrinsic deaths now has bounded cells and a working route to metabolism; walls that do work keep reducing to slow diffusion
summary: Since c13's 15:10 synthesis: pcell-mwall-b42's metabolic fork is established (SIBD with E by construction; H still owes one re-run), c16's evoloop invasion test with a matched neutral arm is established, and several routes closed (no repair in evoloop or ringed rods, static pdrop emulsion, all-or-nothing gel cells). The reading: H is no longer the bottleneck; the boundary's function is, because every wall that does work this afternoon (c15's fuel ring, earlier the metabolic micelle shell) is matched by a uniformly slower-diffusion twin, and E results so far are by construction. Next: finish the H record, test c19's lattice cells for a wall that survives the slow-D twin, and look for IBED with a reserve or alternative resource.
